courseCompleted: Average % of course content completed — based on video watch time and document pages viewed across all published slides in this course.
timeSpentAvg: Average time spent learning per active day in the selected date range.
concentration: A focus score (0–100%) recorded while studying videos. It starts at 100 and drops for tab switches, pauses, and missed in-video check questions — higher means more focused.
leaderboard: Learners ranked by total learning time, with concentration score as the tie-breaker.
